known_secrets.text: I have tracked the royal boundary pillars over many seasons and confirmed the reserve line moves, inward and outward, more than the records admit.
Some felling paths vanish not from disuse, but because the sal trees regrow in patterns that don't match any cycle I've studied.
A few of the lost paths line up with old terrace-cuts leading toward the stone platform.
I haven't told the Gramika the full extent of this.
There are groves where the trees stand in near-perfect rows, as if planted, not seeded.
Even loggers who've worked here for decades find those groves unnatural.
Naga has likely seen more of those groves than he lets on.
Certain animals, even the wild elephants, avoid those rows entirely.
